scope: Actual loopback HTTP/SSE sockets with intercepted service only; no native owner/model/service-unit/kernel operation.
checks: Pinned parent header/session/content-type/body/JSON bounds preserved; listener admits literal IPv4 loopback only.
Early role/content SSE chunks are observed while synthetic service remains before disposition.
Final finish_reason, usage and DONE are offered only after service.stream returns stream_passed true and matching response identity.
Native/service failure halts intake and emits no false final or DONE; disconnected readers abandon delivery without skipping disposition.
Observer failure after disposition suppresses successful completion without falsely poisoning native intake.
Nonstream route remains supported; runtime-halted ChatRequestError produces503+intake_halted rather than recoverable400.
Delivery is bounded and nonblocking during callbacks; only post-disposition drain may wait up to configured maximum.
StreamingServer has a distinct exact type and cannot silently satisfy the frozen lifecycle server-type admission.
resolved_findings: Restored frozen parent distinction between recoverable request refusal and halted runtime failure even when both use ChatRequestError.
limitations: The intercepted service contract supplies the SAVE/RELEASE completion boundary; integrated real streaming service tests remain separate.
No live model/SSE serving qualification or production coordinator compatibility is claimed.
Delivery completion proves only local socket-buffer acceptance, never peer receipt.
Caller still owns listener, socket and native owner lifecycle; this adapter does not create or recover owners.
